On the other hand, if the goal is to promote hypertrophy to maximize muscular strength, there appears little reason to employ loads less than approximately 70% of 1RM, other than perhaps during deload periods. The compelling body of research indicates the presence of a strength-endurance continuum, in which lighter loads promote the ability to carry out submaximal resistive efforts at the expense of maximal force production (39).
